resync_safety.reason: The mirror tree is built from the working tree. At 2026-09-09T06:57Z, 21 of 32 servers had uncommitted src/index.ts edits and all 21 had been rebuilt, so their dist carries the in-flight text. mcp-license depends on mcp-timezone and every server depends on mcp-license, so every mirror's vendored closure is affected. servers/timezone fails 2 of 6 of its own contract tests in the monorepo right now.
resync_safety.measurement: git status --porcelain | grep '^ M servers/' -> 21; dist/index.js newer than src/index.ts for all 21; node --test servers/timezone/test/contract.test.mjs -> 3 pass 2 fail
guards_added: REQUIRE_CLEAN=1 turns either into a skip
resync_safety.guard_proof: REQUIRE_CLEAN=1 scripts/sync-mirrors.sh petty-cash -> skipped, vendored mcp-billing-docs is dirty and rebuilt
resync_safety.run_when: monorepo npm test green and the description work committed
order: fresh clone + npm install && npm run build && npm test + gh run list

squash_recommendation.why: The one-commit history was an artefact of force-pushing a fresh git init, not of low activity, and the mirrors may become the public repository every registry entry points at (docs/VSCODE_GALLERY_R1.md).

fallbacks.SQUASH=1: force-push a single squashed commit, discarding history

squash_recommendation.no_silent_fallback: a failed fetch fails that mirror and pushes nothing, rather than force-pushing over the history it could not read
squash_recommendation.push_mode: plain fast-forward, verified afterwards against git ls-remote
